latest_release.name: Tabler v1.7.4
latest_release.body:
## Core changes

- 7ecb816: Fixed `.card-table` bottom border on the last `tfoot` row and on row header `th` cells, and kept the rule above a `tfoot`.
- 4d92aae: Updated `$border-color-translucent-dark` to white at 8% so card, table and dropdown borders stay visible in dark mode.
- dd50698: Fixed Tabler Icons webfont `.ti` size in `.empty-icon` and its alignment in `.dropdown-item-icon`.
- 141b9f3: Fixed dropdown menus in an expanded `.navbar` overflowing the viewport edge by letting Popper position them.
- 9ccd968: Fixed hard-coded colors and shadows in `.ribbon`, `.loader`, `.stars`, `.card-cover`, forms and marketing with CSS variables.
- 93191c3: Fixed hard-coded `1px` borders, font weights, hero font sizes and transition times to use the shared tokens.

## Demo changes

- 3c81e6d: Fixed the dashboard welcome card illustration to use the `Illustration` component, so it follows dark mode.

## Docs changes

- f7ab6f7: Fixed table of contents links in the docs not updating the URL `#fragment` after clicking.

detail.readme_excerpt:
Free and open source HTML dashboard UI kit built on Bootstrap 5.

Live demo · Documentation · Releases · Discussions

## Table of contents - [Preview](#-preview) - [Quick start](#-quick-start) - [What's included](#-whats-included) - [Frameworks](#-frameworks) - [Ecosystem](#-ecosystem) - [Documentation](#-documentation) - [Browser support](#-browser-support) - [Contributing](#-contributing) - [Sponsors](#-sponsors) - [Creators](#-creators) - [Contributors](#-contributors) - [License](#-license) ## 🔎 Preview Tabler is a set of ready-made layouts, components and demo pages for admin panels, dashboards and web apps. Every component is built on Bootstrap 5, works in light and dark mode, and can be customized with Sass or CSS custom properties.

- Bootstrap 5 ships inside the package, so you only need one CSS file and one JS file. - There are more than 120 demo pages in the [live demo](https://preview.tabler.io): dashboards, forms, tables, auth screens, error pages, marke
